text:
The user wants Sora's forward walk to look like the Goku walk reference. Attached, in order:

1. Sora's current forward walk cycle sprite sheet (4x3, 11 frames, read left to right, top to bottom; 12th cell blank).

2. The same walk as a looping GIF.

3. A frame sheet of the Goku reference walk (4x3, every 4th frame of the GIF).

4. The Goku reference GIF itself.




Sora's walk is rendered from the KH2 rig in Blender. Current settings: 11 drawings held [4,3,3,4,4,4,4,3,3,4,4] = 40 game frames at 60 fps; root moves 65 px per cycle at constant speed; centre bone 0.12 m below the battle idle; feet go from 0.68 m apart (closest) to 1.04 m (widest) along the walk direction, lateral spread x1.2; knees splayed; stepping-foot lift capped at 1 cm; 6 px extra pelvis drop on passing frames; mune pitch 3.5 deg forward on contacts, 0 on passing, 2 deg roll toward the weight leg; both hands stay on the Keyblade handle, which lags up 5 cm on passing and down 3 cm on contacts with a -8 deg drag. Sora must keep both hands on the Keyblade (the user's rule), so arm poses cannot copy Goku's raised fists.




Please compare the two walks closely and tell Claude exactly what needs to change, with concrete values on the rig (bones: center, hara, mune, kubi, atama, L/R_kata, ude1, ude2, te, buki, momo, sune, ashi1, ashi2), so Sora's forward walk matches how Goku's walk looks: stance width and depth, knee direction, how the feet travel and plant, the body's up/down and side-to-side motion, torso lean and twist, head motion, and timing/rhythm.
